$Comment: Throwing a Snowball, in the game's own order: the throw animation with the game's swing sound, a half-second cooldown, the snowball leaves the hand (Christmas_Snowball_Projectile), the throw counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Throw, and only then is one snowball taken from the hand. Spending it last is what lets the last snowball of a stack finish its own throw. Lifetime is the longest the snowball can stay in the world, in seconds: the game removes it then even if it never lands (thrown off a cliff, or the thrower left). Raise the Cooldown for slower snowball fights.
